findings.body: Raise: Not done. The cached searches cover only the current week and six full weeks. For a story still in progress with a part merged eight weeks ago, a teammate without local timing logs cannot get that part's PR body. `board.py:577–580` then builds its runway without the published intervals, so the story's working and waiting time differs between machines.
findings.title: Not done: older merged parts lose their shared runway

findings.body: Raise: Functional. The new no-worktree advice handles a ready fix when `_item` is called, but `forge next` reaches fixes only by iterating local worktrees (`nextstep.py:206–217`). On a second clone with the fix's fetched branch and shared clean record but no fix worktree, `forge board --json` shows it ready while `forge next` never names it or its starter.
findings.title: Not done: forge next omits ready fixes without a worktree
